commands.name: engrams
commands.output:
wisp: A will-o'-the-wisp in a night fen. It flies where it likes, its ghost fire burning the colour of your work, and speaks in flickers.
spirit: The first Eidola Vessel: a figure of drifting gold dust.
skull: A grinning skull in chunky dithered bone.
moon: A sleepy crescent moon drawn in frosted scanlines.
sigil: A spell circle of sparks whose wheels turn faster as work picks up.
kraken: Something vast in the deep water beside your work. It surfaces when there is work to do.
lich: A crowned skull of alchemical signs, soul-fire in its sockets. It burns brighter while you work.
starfield: Stars streaming past at warp, quicker when busy.
